Class SlotGroupPanelAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.inject.SlotGroupPanelAdapter
public final class SlotGroupPanelAdapter extends Object
Adapter that anchors a Panel to a slot group's bounding box. Parallel to ScreenPanelAdapter in shape — same background-render + content-padding + origin + render + click machinery — but the bounds input is a SlotGroupBounds (the bounding box of a category's slots within a screen) rather than a screen frame.

See Design Docs/Phase 12.5/M8_FOUR_CONTEXT_MODEL.md §5 for design and §7.2 for targeting semantics.

Targeting

Adapters declare target categories via .on(SlotGroupCategory...). Exact-category match, not inheritance — categories are flat tags. A single adapter can target multiple categories; the panel renders once per category that resolves in the current screen (so an adapter targeting both PLAYER_INVENTORY and FURNACE_INPUT renders twice in a furnace screen: once anchored to the player inventory, once to the furnace input).

No .onAny() — SlotGroupContext targeting is always explicit category enumeration; "any slot group" isn't a meaningful consumer mental model (see M8 §5.6). Construction without a .on(...) call leaves the adapter in SlotGroupPanelRegistry's pending set; the boot checkpoint fails with IllegalStateException naming the panel ID.

  • Constructor Details

    • SlotGroupPanelAdapter

      public SlotGroupPanelAdapter(Panel panel, SlotGroupRegion region)
      Constructs an adapter with default content padding. Registration into the per-(category, region) slot-group map happens lazily in on(SlotGroupCategory...) — at construction we don't yet know which categories this adapter targets. Uses RegionAnchor.DEFAULT_PRIORITY for sibling ordering; pair with the RegionAnchor constructor below for explicit priority.

      Padding defers to Panel.interiorPadding() — 0 for PanelStyle.NONE (element edge = panel edge), DEFAULT_PADDING for styled panels. Consumers who want a different value pass it via the explicit-padding constructor overload.

    • SlotGroupPanelAdapter

      public SlotGroupPanelAdapter(Panel panel, SlotGroupRegion region, int padding)
      Constructor with explicit content padding. Uses RegionAnchor.DEFAULT_PRIORITY for sibling ordering.

    • SlotGroupPanelAdapter

      public SlotGroupPanelAdapter(Panel panel, RegionAnchor<SlotGroupRegion> anchor)
      Region-aware constructor accepting a RegionAnchor — a slot-group region paired with an explicit stacking priority (e.g. SlotGroupRegion.RIGHT_ALIGN_TOP.priority(50)). Use when sibling slot-group panels in the same (category, region) pair need deterministic ordering relative to each other.

      Padding defers to Panel.interiorPadding() (0 for NONE, 7 otherwise) — same style-conditional default as the ScreenPanelAdapter/VanillaScreenPanelAdapter RegionAnchor constructors.

  • Method Details

    • on

      public SlotGroupPanelAdapter on(SlotGroupCategory... categories)
      Declares the slot-group categories this adapter applies to. Resolution is exact-match — each category named here triggers one render pass per frame on any screen where the category resolves to a non-empty slot list. See M8 §5.2 for why categories are flat tags (no inheritance).

      Registers the adapter's panel under each (category, region) pair in RegionRegistry's slot-group stacking map so multi-adapter stacking within the same (category, region) pair works consistently.

      Call exactly once per adapter. Duplicate declarations throw IllegalStateException.

    • unregister

      public void unregister()
      Phase 16j R5 — removes this adapter from every internal collection: the per-(category, region) bucket in SlotGroupRegionRegistry, the PENDING + REGISTERED sets in SlotGroupPanelRegistry, and the per-panel padding metadata. After unregister() this adapter contributes nothing to layout, dispatch, or rendering. Idempotent.
